_comment: Force-update + recommended-update policy for the Fuelo mobile app. Edit minimum_version when a release becomes mandatory (older versions then show a blocking modal). update_url is the destination — Play Store, App Store, or Firebase App Distribution tester URL while in beta. message_es is shown to the user.
message_es: Esta versión de Fuelo ya no es compatible. Actualízala para seguir usándola.
